item.title: The Missouri Highway Patrol reports the arrest of a man from Neelyville.
item.description: 54 year old Robert Widding was arrested for felony resisting arrest by fleeing. Felony driving while revoked and possession of drug paraphernalia. He was taken to the Ripley County Sheriff’s Office and placed on a 24-hour hold.

item.title: A man from West Plains was injured in a two-vehicle accident west of West Plains on Monday.
item.description: The Highway Patrol reports that the 45-year-old man suffered minor injuries when he crossed the center of the road and hit a truck driven by a 60-year-old man from Viola. The man from Viola was not injured.
